sections.content:
Big discovery!
1. LEFT moved the gray to the right: 15-23 → 18-26?! Wait, before LEFT the gray's top bar was 15-23, and after LEFT it's 18-26. That's 3 to the right! And DOWN moved the gray down 3 (rows 18→21)!
So the movement model has completely changed! Previously LEFT moved the gray 6 to the left. Now LEFT moved it 3 to the right, and DOWN moved it 3 down.
Hmm wait, what changed? Let me re-read. Before this snippet: gray top bar 15-23 (rows 18-20). After LEFT: top bar 18-26, rows 18-20. So the gray moved 3 to the right on a LEFT command?! And after DOWN: rows 21-23, columns 18-26 — moved 3 down.
This is bizarre. Unless... the gray piece is a mirror of the black piece, and the black piece is what's being moved! Wait, the black didn't move in the previous probes. Let me check the black now. My snap didn't output the black this time. Let me check.
Actually wait — maybe I misread earlier. Let me re-verify: in the previous probes, LEFT moved the gray from 21-29 to 15-23 (6 left), then 15-23 to 9-17 (6 left), and RIGHT moved 9-17 to 15-23 (6 right). This time LEFT moved 15-23 to 18-26 (3 right)?!
Something changed. What's different? The timer? No. Hmm.
Oh wait. Maybe the gray piece is the mirror of the black piece, and the black piece is what's being moved by the arrow keys, and the gray follows as the mirror. In the previous probes, the black was... let me check whether the black moved. I wasn't outputting the black in this last snippet! In the previous snippets, the black stayed at 45-53. But this time the black might have moved!
If the black moved 3 to the left (45→42), the mirror (c'=74-c) would move 3 to the right: 42-50 → mirror 24-32... no wait. Black top bar 45-53 → mirror 21-29. If the black moves 3 left to 42-50, the mirror is 24-32. The gray is now 18-26. Doesn't match.
Hmm, let me just check the black's current position anyway.
Actually, another possibility: maybe the arrow keys move the black piece, and the gray is a mirror, but the black piece is... in the previous probes the black didn't move at all on LEFT/RIGHT/DOWN/UP. And the gray moved 6 in the pressed direction (LEFT → gray 6 left; RIGHT → gray 6 right).
This time: LEFT → gray 3 right, DOWN → gray 3 down.
The difference: the timer? 58 vs 61? No...
Wait, maybe the gray piece is the mirror of the black piece, and the black piece is what's being moved, and the reason the black didn't move before was... hmm, no.
Let me look at the image: the gray is now in the upper center-left (columns 18-26), the black is in the upper right (looks like 45-53), and the yellow is in the lower left. The gray has moved slightly to the right and down compared to before.
Let me check the black's position and re-derive. I'll also test RIGHT and UP to map out the movement.
